notes: The San Francisco City Planning Commission's minutes of its regular and special meetings, January to December 1970, from the four quarterly volumes the San Francisco Public Library contributed to the Internet Archive (12-15minutesofsanfran1970sa). Pages were split from the hOCR search text on the Internet Archive page index, minus the two colour cards per volume, so every citation names the viewer page the fact is on (checked against a citation of the 1968-1969 batch). Every page is dated from the meeting header it sits under. Two kinds of finding per case: what the Commission decided, dated to the meeting that decided it, and what the minutes state stood on the property; plus dated past facts the minutes state about a building, chiefly in landmark reports. A proposal on its own is not a finding. The minutes name applicants, owners, attorneys, objectors, commissioners and staff throughout; the reader spec barred all of them from every field, and kept companies, institutions, named buildings, architects and long-dead historical figures a landmark report associates with a building.

coverage.remaining: Every page of the four 1970 volumes (12minutesofsanfran1970sa, 13minutesofsanfran1970sa, 14minutesofsanfran1970sa, 15minutesofsanfran1970sa) was read. Volumes 16-39 (1971-1980) and 40-58 (1994-2005) remain. Of the 205 unresolved, 148 are located only by a block, a corner, a bearing or a building name with no page to carry it; 25 have no EAS record at the number; 25 are condominium parcels today; 7 are ranges now split across parcels. 27 of the 148 print their own block and lot and were looked up in sf-parcels: each names several lots or a lot with no address, and stays unresolved.
coverage.note: 1,478 OCR pages with text across four quarterly volumes, read by eight parallel readers from one written spec; 50 meetings, regular and special, 281 agenda items heard (a case heard at several meetings counted at each), 233 of them about a property the minutes locate. 455 findings: 217 statements of what stood on a property, 183 decisions the Commission took, 47 dated past facts the minutes state about a building, 8 landmark designations. Every quote was re-anchored mechanically against its own page before the file was written (455 of 455 anchored). 250 resolved: 199 by the EAS join on a printed number, 18 by name on a building a page already carries, 33 by the record's own printed block and lot where that names one active parcel with one address. 235 published on 116 pages (113 address pages, 73 of them seeded, and 3 Recreation and Park place pages); 15 declined: 11 already on the page or adding nothing to it, 4 not a fact about the building (a speaker's arithmetic for a date, a speaker's characterisation, an opinion of a renovation, a private purchase).
